Initial release of Maker Japanese — Create Japanese-Style Videos Fast

- Create Japanese-style videos with native text overlays and transitions by uploading clips and giving simple instructions.
- Automated 1080p MP4 export with minimal manual editing; supports clips up to 500MB.
- Handles session management and authentication transparently, including free credits for new users.
- Supports standard video/audio/image file types; error handling for unsupported formats and quota issues.
- Quick timeline previews, with workflows for single and batch edits.
- Designed for fast content creation targeting Japanese platforms.
